senses.gloss: f. (a corrupt. of גרהוקא, carruca, καροῦχα, καῤῥοῦχα) a carriage used by persons of distinction (v. Sm. Ant. s. v.).
units: <cite ref="Taanit 20b:11">Taan. 20ᵇ</cite> <he>ג׳ דדהבא</he> a gilt carruca (aurea carruca, v. Sm. Ant. l. c.); <cite ref="Gittin 31b:12">Gitt. 31ᵇ</cite>.
<cite ref="Bava Metzia 73b:8">B. Mets. 73ᵇ</cite> <he>מעייל להו בג׳ דרבא</he> made them draw Raba’s carriage.
<cite ref="Bava Metzia 85b:9">Ib. 85ᵇ</cite> <he>ג׳ דר׳ חייא</he> the carriage in which R. Ḥiya will rise to heaven.—Pl. <he>גּוּהַרְקֵי</he>.
<cite ref="Bava Metzia 85b:9">Ib.</cite> <he>בכולהו ג׳</he> Ms. H. (v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note 90).
